messages.subject: Completion bible — Project Tamar
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi Tom,

Please find the index for the Project Tamar completion bible for your review ahead of Friday's signing. Let me know if anything is missing from the conditions schedule.

Rachel

[Sent in error — James, apologies, this was meant for Tom Gallagher on a different matter. Please disregard. — Rachel]
